description: This file contains implementation of number parsing functions, including StringToNumber wrappers and ParseIntHelper template, for converting strings to integers with format validation.

methods.name: StringToNumber
methods.description: Wrapper functions for converting StringPiece to various integer types.

methods.name: SetError
methods.description: Sets the ParseIntError and returns false.

methods.name: ParseIntHelper
methods.description: Template function that parses a string into an integer with format validation.

methods.name: ParseInt32
methods.description: Parses a string into a 32-bit integer with specified format.

methods.name: ParseInt64
methods.description: Parses a string into a 64-bit integer with specified format.

methods.name: ParseUint32
methods.description: Parses a string into a 32-bit unsigned integer with specified format.

methods.name: ParseUint64
methods.description: Parses a string into a 64-bit unsigned integer with specified format.
